rule: A void is an explicit, fixed geometry with a documented reason (SPEC.md section 3), defined before any score under v0.1 and never derived from targets, labels or detector output. An empty table means the evaluated area has no void.

verden.evidence: Staged-terrain void gate, D1-COLLAPSE-1 session 3 (lgln_reader.py void): void share 0.0 in all 717 scored windows (275 positive, 442 background); no background rectangle not wholly valid.

oldenburg.evidence: Staged-terrain void gate, ADAPT-NDS-1 session 1 (nds_reader.py void): void share 0.0 in 698 of 699 scored windows (258 positive, 440 background); no background rectangle not wholly valid. The remaining positive window's scored core is a 0.43 m x 419 m sliver (181 m2, an ownership-partition remainder) that holds no 1 m pixel centre, so its void share is undefined; it is not a void. The CONFIRM staging plan pins every DGM1 file by sha256, so a re-staging reads identical bytes or fails.
